exposure: hemoglobin A1C levels in the second and third trimesters
cohort: The study included 373 gestational diabetes (GDM) patients, sub-grouped into obese and non-obese, who were treated with either diet or insulin regimens.
finding: Pre-pregnancy body mass index, weight gained during pregnancy, hemoglobin A1C levels in the second and third trimesters, and caesarean rates were higher in insulin-treated obese GDM patients compared to other groups.
mod_finding: Caesarean rates were higher in insulin-treated obese patients compared to other groups.
